name: caller-principal-require-pre-edit-admits-the-bound-principal
description: R14 for pre-edit, a require-class route both runtimes implement, in the PRINCIPAL-PRESENT state: session A claims (Python only -- the preflight is scoped, since Node answers 404) and its pre-edit presents the principal. Python checks it and admits; Node issues none, so the harness omits the header there, exactly as a conforming client does after a 404 on the claim. Both answer the same. The absent-and-bound state is fixture 17 (Python refuses) and 18 (Node admits); absent-and-unbound is warn_mode/04-pre-edit-tracked-grants-exclusive.
